clue.text: In little time auditor became visibly depressed

parts.note: taken as written
T is the standard abbreviation for time
the ears are what does the listening, so the hearer is represented by them

explanation.surface: A listener who quickly got upset and started crying.
explanation.walkthrough: 'became' is a link joining wordplay to definition; the auditor is stood in for by the organs that hear.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone weeping openly is plainly showing their sadness, an idiom for crying.

clue.text: Unusually tempting hotel in process of change

indicators.note: unusually says the letters of the next three words are set out in an unusual new order

explanation.surface: A hotel that is unusually tempting while being refurbished.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes something still being reshaped or undecided, like metal being melted down.

clue.text: Nurse confines fellow in consequence

indicators.note: confines means the treating word holds the fellow word shut inside it

parts.note: to nurse a patient is to treat them
a fellow is a man, he

explanation.surface: A nurse keeps a man locked up, with consequences.
explanation.definitionFit: An old-fashioned adverb meaning because of that or as a result, a synonym of the phrase.

clue.text: Going on and on like this could make one sick

definitions.text: Going on and on like this could make one sick

parts.words: Going on and on like this could make one sick
parts.note: the Latin tag for droning on tediously literally means to the point of nausea, so it would make one sick

explanation.surface: Someone who talks endlessly is enough to make you ill.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase means repeated to a sickening degree, literally to the point of nausea.

clue.text: Oddly enough, it's seen in verse form

indicators.note: oddly enough says the letters are arranged in an odd, unexpected way

parts.note: the apostrophe adds no letter

explanation.surface: Curiously, the thing appears in a poem.
explanation.definitionFit: A sestina-type poem of six-line stanzas is a fixed form of poetry.

clue.text: Toddle along to wild parties

indicators.note: wild says the letters of parties run riot into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone wanders off to some riotous parties.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean walk about in a casual or wearisome manner.

clue.text: Strong supporter makes articulate oriental smile

indicators.note: articulate means the words are to be spoken out, so their sound gives the entry

parts.note: a smile from Thailand would be a Thai beam

explanation.surface: A strong backer gives an eloquent Eastern grin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'articulate' looks like an adjective but is the verb: say THAI BEAM and you hear a building timber.
explanation.definitionFit: A horizontal timber tying the rafters together is a strong structural support in a roof.

clue.text: A Hebrew

parts.note: read not as a person but as the Hebrew equivalent of the letter A

explanation.surface: A Jewish person is mentioned.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the first letter of the Hebrew alphabet, corresponding to our A.

clue.text: Advocating force with no condition

parts.note: advocating something is being for it, pro
vis is Latin for force, as in vis viva
O is the figure zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Arguing for violence without strings attached.
explanation.definitionFit: A clause adding a stipulation to an agreement is a condition.

clue.text: Removing academic differentials daily

explanation.surface: A paper that campaigns to level out academic differences.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the first part as 'evening' (making even) 'standard' (level of attainment).
explanation.definitionFit: Levelling out standards is evening them; the London newspaper of that name is a daily.

clue.text: About to enter several wooden items

indicators.note: to enter means the about word goes inside the several word

parts.note: ten is taken as several
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A bit about getting into a few wooden things.
explanation.definitionFit: Small domestic objects turned from wood, such as bowls, are known collectively by this name.

clue.text: Woman and daughter in repository for worker on the docks

indicators.note: in means the woman and daughter go inside the repository

parts.note: a store is a place where things are kept
Eve, the first woman
D is the abbreviation for daughter in family trees

explanation.surface: A mother and daughter in a warehouse employing a dockhand.
explanation.definitionFit: A docker loading and unloading ships is a synonym.

clue.text: Do include small number of administrators

definitions.note: the singular noun is used collectively for a body of managers

indicators.note: include means the doing word takes the number inside it

parts.note: to do a task is to execute it
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Bring in a few managers.
explanation.definitionFit: The executive is the body of managers running an organisation.

clue.text: Hawaii grabs small island in the Caribbean

indicators.note: grabs means the Hawaii letters hold the island between them

parts.note: HI is the US postal code for Hawaii
an ait is a small river island

explanation.surface: One island state seizes a little one in the Caribbean.
explanation.definitionFit: The country shares Hispaniola in the Caribbean Sea with the Dominican Republic.

clue.text: Some of the text, remember, is quite radical

indicators.note: Some of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Part of the writing, bear in mind, is pretty revolutionary.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition included 'is', but an adjective must stand for the answer, so 'is' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Something far from the mainstream is very radical, a synonym.

clue.text: John played in periodical game

indicators.note: in means the rearranged name sits inside the periodical

parts.note: a mag is a magazine, a periodical

indicators.note: played means the letters of John are rearranged

explanation.surface: John took part in a magazine competition.
explanation.definitionFit: A Chinese tile game for four players.

clue.text: Pelts round a road, then retreats

indicators.note: round means the skins word goes about the other pieces

parts.note: pelts are animal skins, hides
a way is a road

explanation.surface: Skins encircle a road before withdrawal.
explanation.definitionFit: Hideaways are secluded places one retires to, retreats.

clue.text: The underwear a balloonist wants?

explanation.surface: Joking that a balloonist needs warm long johns.
explanation.definitionFit: Warm long underwear goes by this name, and a rising current of warm air lifts a balloon.

clue.text: Once a legislator the French saw as a paradigm

parts.note: ex means former, once
an MP is a Member of Parliament
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A former French politician seen as a role model.
explanation.definitionFit: A paradigm is a model or pattern to be copied.

clue.text: Shuffles along carrying loads

explanation.surface: Someone trudges along with heavy burdens.
explanation.definitionFit: Lumbers means moves heavily and clumsily; it also means saddles with a burden.

clue.text: Beef when socialist takes many to lunch

parts.note: red is a left-wing socialist
M is a thousand in Roman numerals, a large number
to lunch is to eat

explanation.surface: Beef served when a left-winger treats a crowd to lunch.
explanation.definitionFit: Beef is the prime example of dark-coloured meat from cattle.

clue.text: Government's recommended diets

explanation.surface: Official dietary advice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Government's' is read as 'Governments' in the first sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Regimes are governments or systems of rule; it is also a variant for prescribed regimens.

clue.text: Model mince-pie, as I see it

indicators.note: mince means chop up, so the letters of pie are minced

parts.note: as I see it means to me, in my view

explanation.surface: Someone judges a mince pie to be perfect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mince-pie' looks like one festive item; 'mince' is the anagram signal working on 'pie'.
explanation.definitionFit: The epitome of something is its perfect model or embodiment.

clue.text: Cattle herder initially found below

parts.note: neat is an old word for cattle

indicators.note: initially means only the first letter of herder is taken

explanation.surface: A cowherd was first discovered underneath.
explanation.definitionFit: A poetic shortening of beneath, meaning under.

clue.text: Prevaricate when it comes to a boundary

explanation.surface: Dithering over a property boundary.
explanation.definitionFit: To hedge is to avoid committing oneself; a row of bushes marks the edge of a field.

clue.text: Am I to ring about popular trek?

indicators.note: about means the letters are turned around into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Should I phone about a well-liked journey?
explanation.definitionFit: A seasonal mass movement of many animals or people is a trek made by a multitude.

clue.text: Fantasia for the organ? Unlikely hope!

explanation.surface: Wishing for an organ fantasy.
explanation.definitionFit: A fantasia played on organ pipes would be piped dreaming; a fanciful hope that will never come true.

clue.text: Pole leaves popular goat in the market

indicators.note: leaves means the pole letter departs from the goat

parts.note: an Angora is a breed of goat prized for mohair
N is the north pole

explanation.surface: A Polish man walks away from a favourite goat at the marketplace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'popular' only describes the goat in the surface. 'Pole' looks like a Polish person; it is the north pole.
explanation.definitionFit: In ancient Greece the agora was the public marketplace and meeting place.

clue.text: People here meet American hero of old

parts.note: people here are these, the ones present
US, the United States

explanation.surface: Locals encounter an American legendary figure.
explanation.definitionFit: The Athenian prince who killed the Minotaur is a hero of Greek legend.

clue.text: Declare an adjournment, hang it!

explanation.surface: Exasperated, someone calls a break in proceedings.
explanation.definitionFit: To suspend a hearing is to adjourn it; to suspend something is to hang it from above.
